text:
incident-bot: Pager: high 5xx rate observed from prod-edge in eu-west-1. Alert: INGRESS_TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE spike > 12% over 5m. Pager sent to @eng-oncall.

maya: seeing the spike in Grafana as well, started ~ 09:12 UTC. Lots of client TLS handshakes failing. 5xx are mostly 525/502 from the edge.

alex: i can reproduce a failed handshake from a client in london. openssl shows an expired cert in the chain. quick check:
```
openssl s_client -connect api.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername api.prod.redwood.ai -showcerts
---
subject=CN = api.prod.redwood.ai
issuer=C = US, O = Let\'sEncrypt, CN = R3
---
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
verify return:1
```
Looks like the intermediate returned by our edge is the old R3 intermediate (expired cross-signed).

jordan: confirmed in edge logs: `edge/ingress` is logging `tls: certificate verify failed: certificate has expired` from upstream during client handshake proxying. Occurring across a subset of frontends in eu-west-1.

samir: is this the rotator not picking up the new chain? I just checked the rotator status page — shows last rotation 2026-03-08 02:00 UTC and a queued chain upload failed with 409 earlier. Might be a publishing race between rotator -> s3 -> edge.

maya: customer impact: CS dashboard shows ~8% of requests returning 5xx for EU customers, some reporting API errors. katie-cs looped in and is drafting a short customer note.

katie-cs: filing CS note now. main ask: ETA to mitigation. customers want workaround (retry / regional host).

alex: immediate plan: 1) switch affected frontends to serve the backup chain we keep in s3 (cross-signed intermediate) 2) enable degraded routing for eu -> eu-fallback region for affected routes 3) investigate rotator failure.

maya: do we have a safe toggle for serving chain override?

ops-bot: runbook snippet: `edge.cert.override` exists as a runtime flag for immediate chain substitution. Requires config push via config-service and no frontend restart.

alex: pushing override now (will target eu-west-1 only).
```
# config push
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://config.prod.redwood.ai/v1/overrides \
  -d '{"target":"edge.eu-west-1","cert_chain_s3":"s3://prod-cert-backups/r3-cross-signed.pem"}'
```

ops-bot: config push accepted, rollout id: r-7642. Incremental rollout to eu-west-1 frontends initiated.

jordan: seeing rollouts hit ~30% of frontends in 20s, no increased errors so far.

maya: monitoring: 5xx% dropped from 12% -> 3.6% within 90s in eu-west-1. still not zero but much better.

alex: running live curl checks from eu probe:
```
curl -v --resolve api.prod.redwood.ai:443:34.72.18.11 https://api.prod.redwood.ai/health
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Finished
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
Good responses from updated frontends.

samir: I'm rolling a fix for the rotator publish path — found a race when S3 object metadata upload returns 409 if object already exists while new rotation also attempts to write. Adding idempotent put + backoff. Will push a patch to rotator in 15m.

katie-cs: customer comms: short note posted to affected customers: "We observed TLS handshake failures for some EU traffic caused by an intermediate cert mismatch. We've applied a temporary chain override; full fix and postmortem forthcoming."

maya: action items: alex keep the override until rotator fix is validated and we reissue chain via normal flow. samir please confirm rotator patch and a safe rotation window. jorden/fw team to run a full cert validation sweep across all regions.

alex: creating a follow-up ticket: INC-2795 - "edge: intermediate chain publish race -> expired intermediate served" with steps taken and timeline. assigning to infra/rotator + eng-sre.

ops-bot: incident severity set to Sev2. Paging suspended. On-call handoff scheduled at 10:00 UTC.

jordan: leaving now, handing to @maya for next 30m while I finish a quick canary audit.

maya: got it. will monitor for 30m and confirm rotator patch before removing override.

samir: rotator PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/rotator/pulls/432 - includes idempotent upload + 5s backoff + verification step. requesting hotfix deploy to prod-edge-control-plane.

alex: can someone run a staged rotation once PR is live? we need to verify edge picks up the new chain via normal rotation, then remove override.

ops-bot: hotfix deploy triggered by @samir: deploy id dpl-9921. Will run deploy hooks and notify on success/failure.

incident-bot: dpl-9921: hotfix deploy succeeded.

maya: running a staged rotation now. pushing new chain through rotator.

alex: monitoring: rotation propagated, edges pulling chain version v2026-03-15-01. Watching health.

maya: 5xx% in eu-west-1 back to baseline ~0.6%. good. removing override in 2m to confirm normal rotation works.

ops-bot: override removed for target edge.eu-west-1, rollout id r-7642-rollback.

jordan: verifying with probes: all probes green from eu regions.

katie-cs: updated customer note: full fix applied, rotation validated, override removed. PM requested a postmortem.

samir: rotator metrics show no more 409s after hotfix. scheduling a thorough e2e rotation test in staging and prod canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

alex: final notes: root cause = rotator publish race causing expired intermediate to remain served by a subset of frontends. mitigation = chain override -> hotfix -> normal rotation.

maya: handing off incident to follow-up owners: INC-2795 assigned to infra/rotator (samir), validation sweep to eng-sre (jordan), CS comms to katie-cs. Severity downgraded to monitoring.

jordan: thanks team. filing brief timeline for postmortem.

incident-bot: thread closed for paging; follow-up actions remain open on INC-2795.
